steps.prompt: You can argue, explain or tell a story. Which kind of essay do you enjoy writing most? Why?

cards.title: Choose your prompt
cards.body: Your final essay can be argumentative, informative or narrative: choose the prompt you know the most about. The Coach, the essay map and Quill check your essay as the kind you choose.

cards.title: Plan, then draft
cards.body: Use the outline builder to plan every part, then press “Start my essay from the outline” and draft every paragraph. Don’t stop to polish: getting it all down is the goal today.

cards.title: Your draft carries on
cards.body: In the last lesson, your final essay starts from this draft, so you can revise it instead of starting again.

prompts: Why did you choose this prompt?
Which part of your draft needs the most work?
